generationPolicy.pathConstraintModel: straight path prototypes preserve endpoint/support roles and repeat interior phases from production examples
generationPolicy.attachmentConstraintModel: cross-family N/E/S/W semantic interfaces choose context-compatible variants and path junction companions
generationPolicy.supportDecorationModel: production-mined support stems are explicit gesture-driven relations; prototypes retain anchor role, span, termination and platform visual context, and horizontal ledge painting never invents supports
generationPolicy.visualAdjacencyModel: production-learned visual adjacency keys and full horizontal edge-run prototypes drive bounded sequence optimization for edge terrain
generationPolicy.inferredConnectorModel: vertical path endpoints can promote an adjacent walkable cell into a derived ladder/walkway junction when production connector constraints support it
